description: GPU Health — ECC, Remapped Rows, Throttle (decoded), PCIe, NVLink, Temps | DGX SuperPOD fleet-scale fleet: offender tables + outliers, not aggregate OK/degraded

options.content: 🏠 NVIS Home

panels.title: 🔴 GPU Error Health — ECC, Remapped Rows, Throttle, PCIe (offenders only)

targets.expr: count(DCGM_FI_DEV_ECC_DBE_VOL_TOTAL{cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"} > 0) or vector(0)
count(DCGM_FI_DEV_ECC_SBE_VOL_TOTAL{cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"} > 0) or vector(0)

count((DCGM_FI_DEV_CORRECTABLE_REMAPPED_ROWS{cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"} + DCGM_FI_DEV_UNCORRECTABLE_REMAPPED_ROWS{cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) > 0) or vector(0)
count(DCGM_FI_DEV_ROW_REMAP_FAILURE{cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"} > 0) or vector(0)
count(bitmap_and(DCGM_FI_DEV_CLOCK_THROTTLE_REASONS{cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}, 232) > 0) or vector(0)
count(DCGM_FI_DEV_PCIE_REPLAY_COUNTER{cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"} > 0) or vector(0)

panels.description: Instant list of GPUs with any ECC error. Empty table = healthy fleet.

targets.expr: max by (node, gpu, modelName, pci_bus_id) (DCGM_FI_DEV_ECC_DBE_VOL_TOTAL{cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})
max by (node, gpu, modelName, pci_bus_id) (DCGM_FI_DEV_ECC_SBE_VOL_TOTAL{cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})
max by (node, gpu, modelName, pci_bus_id) (DCGM_FI_DEV_ECC_DBE_AGG_TOTAL{cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})
max by (node, gpu, modelName, pci_bus_id) (DCGM_FI_DEV_ECC_SBE_AGG_TOTAL{cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})

panels.title: 💀 ECC Error Offenders (DBE = replace/reset, SBE = watch)

panels.description: GPUs with remapped memory rows or a row-remap failure. Any row here = schedule a GPU reset (failure = RMA candidate). Empty = healthy.

targets.expr: max by (node, gpu, modelName, pci_bus_id) (DCGM_FI_DEV_UNCORRECTABLE_REMAPPED_ROWS{cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})
max by (node, gpu, modelName, pci_bus_id) (DCGM_FI_DEV_CORRECTABLE_REMAPPED_ROWS{cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})
max by (node, gpu, modelName, pci_bus_id) (DCGM_FI_DEV_ROW_REMAP_FAILURE{cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})

panels.title: 🧩 Remapped-Row Offenders (reset / RMA)

panels.description: DCGM_FI_DEV_CLOCK_THROTTLE_REASONS decoded per GPU. GPU-Idle(1) and App-Clocks(2) excluded. SW Power Cap is LOGIC-GATED to impacting-only (bit set AND rate(DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_VIOLATION[5m])>0 AND GPU_UTIL>50) — a GPU merely at default TDP while near-idle is NOT shown as Active. 1/⬤ = that reason active now. Empty = no throttling.

targets.expr: max by (node, gpu, modelName) (bitmap_and(DCGM_FI_DEV_CLOCK_THROTTLE_REASONS{cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}, 64) / 64)
max by (node, gpu, modelName) (bitmap_and(DCGM_FI_DEV_CLOCK_THROTTLE_REASONS{cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}, 128) / 128)
max by (node, gpu, modelName) (bitmap_and(DCGM_FI_DEV_CLOCK_THROTTLE_REASONS{cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}, 32) / 32)
max by (node, gpu, modelName) (bitmap_and(DCGM_FI_DEV_CLOCK_THROTTLE_REASONS{cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}, 8) / 8)

max by (node, gpu, modelName) ((bitmap_and(DCGM_FI_DEV_CLOCK_THROTTLE_REASONS{cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}, 4) / 4) and on(node, gpu) (rate(DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_VIOLATION{cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}[5m]) > 0) and on(node, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"} > 50))
max by (node, gpu, modelName) (bitmap_and(DCGM_FI_DEV_CLOCK_THROTTLE_REASONS{cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}, 16) / 16)

panels.title: 🌡️⚡ Throttle Reasons — DECODED (per GPU, real throttling only)

panels.description: GPUs with PCIe replays. Steady growth = check PCIe link/riser/reseating. Empty = healthy.

targets.expr: max by (node, gpu, modelName, pci_bus_id) (DCGM_FI_DEV_PCIE_REPLAY_COUNTER{cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"} > 0)

panels.title: 🔌 PCIe Replay Offenders

panels.description: GPUs accumulating thermal/power/board/reliability violation time (increase over dashboard range). Empty = healthy.

targets.expr: max by (node, gpu, modelName) (increase(DCGM_FI_DEV_THERMAL_VIOLATION{cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}[$__range]))
max by (node, gpu, modelName) (increase(DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_VIOLATION{cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}[$__range]))
max by (node, gpu, modelName) (increase(DCGM_FI_DEV_BOARD_LIMIT_VIOLATION{cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}[$__range]))
max by (node, gpu, modelName) (increase(DCGM_FI_DEV_RELIABILITY_VIOLATION{cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}[$__range]))
max by (node, gpu, modelName) (increase(DCGM_FI_DEV_SYNC_BOOST_VIOLATION{cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}[$__range]))

panels.title: ⚠️ GPU Violation Offenders (increase over range)
🌡️ GPU Temperature & Power — Outliers (topk of thousands of GPUs)

panels.description: Top 20 hottest GPU cores across the fleet. Full ~2300-series view is unreadable, so only the top offenders are drawn.

targets.expr: topk(20, DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP{cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})

panels.title: GPU Core Temp — Top 20 hottest

panels.description: GPUs currently above 80°C core. Empty = all cool.

targets.expr: max by (node, gpu, modelName) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP{cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"} > 80)

panels.title: 🔥 Core Temp Outliers (>80°C)

panels.description: GPUs with memory (HBM) temp above 85°C. Empty = all cool.

targets.expr: max by (node, gpu, modelName) (DCGM_FI_DEV_MEMORY_TEMP{cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"} > 85)

panels.title: 🔥 HBM Mem Temp Outliers (>85°C)

panels.description: Top 20 hottest GPU memory (HBM) modules across the fleet.

targets.expr: topk(20, DCGM_FI_DEV_MEMORY_TEMP{cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})

panels.title: GPU Memory (HBM) Temp — Top 20 hottest

panels.description: Top 20 highest-power GPUs across the fleet.

targets.expr: topk(20, DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_USAGE{cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})

panels.title: GPU Power Usage — Top 20 highest

panels.description: Top 20 GPUs by NVLink bandwidth. There is no DCGM NVLink CRC/error metric — NVLink error EVENTS are surfaced from logs in the section below.

targets.expr: topk(20, rate(DCGM_FI_DEV_NVLINK_BANDWIDTH_TOTAL{cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}[5m]) * 1024 * 1024)

panels.title: NVLink Bandwidth (TX+RX) — Top 20
📜 GPU Error Events — Logs (XID / NVLink / ECC via Loki)

panels.description: Nodes emitting Xid log events over the dashboard range (there is no DCGM XID metric — XID comes from logs). Empty = no XID events.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (count_over_time({cluster=~"$cluster", filename=~"/var/log/(kern.log|syslog)", node=~"$node"} |~ "(?i)\\bxid\\b" [$__range]))

panels.title: 🔴 XID Event Offenders (by node)

panels.description: Raw XID / NVLink error log lines (contains the XID code and affected PCI address). Use the Log Search box to narrow.

targets.expr: {cluster=~"$cluster", filename=~"/var/log/(kern.log|syslog)", node=~"$node"} |~ "(?i)xid|nvlink" |~ "$log_search"

panels.title: 🔴 XID / NVLink Error Log Lines

panels.description: Broader GPU error correlation: NVRM / Xid / ECC / remapped / throttle / power / NVLink across all nodes.

targets.expr: {cluster=~"$cluster", filename=~"/var/log/(kern.log|syslog)", node=~"$node"} |~ "(?i)(NVRM|Xid|double.bit|remapped|ECC|throttl|power|nvlink|hardware error)" |~ "$log_search"

panels.title: 🔴 GPU Error Log Events — NVRM / Xid / ECC / NVLink (all nodes)

list.description: Display label for the DGX platform. The installer sets this from the DGX_FLAVOR env var.
Type keyword + Enter. Default .* shows all. Examples: 79 (XID code), NVLink, node node-xxxx
list.label: 🔍 Log Search
